Lina (People Ops): Heads-up: NestBridge (retirement vendor) just announced consolidation of micro-plans. They set an effective cutover 2024-09-20 and want a successor trustee selection + signed transfer consents. Anyone on benefits loop seen this?
Devon (Payroll): Saw the notice. Concern: payroll cutoff timing. If cutover hits between pay runs we may need an off-cycle to remap contributions.
Rhea (Benefits): Packet attached in vendor portal. They require CSV with `last4,dob,account_type,pre_tax,catchup,loan_balance` and a signed PDF per participant. They also flagged that outstanding loan IDs must be provided for trustee-to-trustee rollovers.
Lina (People Ops): Urgent questions: 1) will in-flight loan amortizations convert to taxable distributions if not rolled? 2) can we centralize signature collection?
Kai (Legal): Potential taxable distributions are real. I'll review our contract for required notice windows. If vendor violated notice timing we can push the cutover. Also OK with central collection if we record consent and retention policy.
Devon (Payroll): Operational note: our payroll vendor requires final mapping CSV 72 hours before the payroll cutoff to affect the next pay run. Pay dates around cutover: 2024-09-13 and 2024-09-27, so we have a buffer.
Rhea (Benefits): Successor trustee (BlueCrest) replied: accepts e-signed consents and loan rollovers if loan IDs match our ledger. They also asked for DOB for matching.
Lina (People Ops): Proposed action list: A) Freeze employee-initiated deferral edits for NestBridge plan until mapping done. B) Export participant ledger (include loan IDs). C) Draft urgent note: "DO NOT change elections for NestBridge plan until we confirm transfers." D) Decide central vs individual signature collection.
Devon (Payroll): I'll export a redacted sample tonight. Example rows ok: `emp_id,last4,pre_tax,catchup,loan_balance,loan_id`
Rhea (Benefits): I'll confirm BlueCrest's ingestion template and whether they accept a zipped batch with signed PDFs named by emp_id.
Kai (Legal): I'll prepare consent language and a short privacy retention policy (7 years) — post by EOD. Also flag international tax issues for a few UK/CA employees.
Lina (People Ops): Team deadlines: Devon export by 2pm, Rhea trustee intake spec by 3pm, Kai consent text by 4pm. I'll draft the urgent note for 5pm send. Anything else?
PolicyBot: Reminder created: vendor-transition-nestbridge assigned to @Rhea @Devon @Lina @Kai.
